rule.targets: a milestone is an answer target when a number in the answer row's targets.numbers equals its value under one of the answer check's unit factors (answer.SCALES) within the milestone display tolerance (0.5%), the test answer.targets uses to make a gold answer value a target; milestones.py records no answer line
rule.route_adjusted: (e3 + REACHED) / (n - NOT_NEEDED); a response whose milestones the judge rules all not needed has no value and is left out (count per model)
